composition.note: Giacomo Puccini died in 1924. This assessment concerns the original composition, not a later edition, arrangement or this recording; it is not a worldwide rights clearance.

recording.value: Rule 2 — sound recording public domain in the United States (first published by 1925).
recording.note: Commons attributes the Muzio performance to 1911 but supplies only general PD-old, not a recording licence. The UCSB-published Bolig discography identifies the original commercial recording as matrix 298aj, recorded in Milan on 20 June 1911, issued as HMV 053264 and Victor 55028. Rule 2 uses this pre-1926 original recording/issue identification, not Puccini’s death or the modern YouTube upload. The exact first-release day is not supplied by that entry.
